profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Airbnb
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer passionate about building products with great UX that are accessible to everyone.

I specialize in iOS accessibility and love working at the UI infrastructure level to find solutions that can improve usability across many surfaces. I also love Design Systems for this reason!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead on the XFN Digital Accessibility team
* iOS A11y Subject Matter Expert (SME)
* Lead cross platform eng roadmap for WCAG and EAA compliance 
* Lead the Accessibility Champions technical program for product engineers 
* Develop and maintain tooling in CI/CD test automation, WCAG issue prevention and remediation AI skills
* Collaborate with and contribute to Design Systems 
* Build tools to improve developer experience and user access 
* Work closely with Design, Product, QA and leadership teams

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Accessibility Tech Lead
• Accessibility engineering tech lead on cross-platform group within Design Systems, a UI infrastructure team.
• Launched dynamic fonts on consumer and business owner iOS apps.
• Build tooling and developer metrics for accessibility.
• Use research, experimentation, and product analytics to guide decision making.
• Create technical roadmap, collaborate cross-org for planning and OKRs, guide and mentor teammates.
• Developed training via workshops and best practices documentation.
• Conduct accessibility audits and work closely with feature teams to provide support.
• Collaborate with designers to ensure the health of the design system.
• Iterate on design system UI components to improve UX for everyone.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
positions.description:
• Leading Accessibility at Yelp!
• Collaborate with the Design team to build and improve our reusable UI components library, Yelp's design system.
• Support product engineers with code samples and reviews
• Document UI library, improve APIs and enhance performance

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
positions.description:
• Built, tested, and maintained large scale consumer-facing iOS features with MVVM on the LinkedIn iOS app.
• Improved the accessibility experience of the LinkedIn Articles page (native and external).
• Contributed to the Newsletters product, by building the Newsletter notifications which has reached millions of LinkedIn users, and by leading the project to support Newsletters in Feed in the U.S. as well as  Zephyr (China app) and Lite (India app).
• Design and scale distributed applications
• Write code, Unit test, and Squash bugs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Agile development in iOS, Mac OS, Vapor, and Ruby on Rails
• Maintain quality code base using Git source control
• Engage in client needs assessments to draft requirement specifications
• Determine project time estimates
• Architect data models
• Design and implement UI and UX
• Code review potential new hires
• Mentor junior developers
• Debugging and quality testing.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
• Calculus I & II
• Pre-Calculus
• Trigonometry
• Algebra I & II
• Pre-Algebra
• Statistics

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Rainbow Community Center of Contra Costa
volunteerExperiences.description:
Administer the youth Halloween Dance celebration and participated in freelance pro-bono professional photography for the event.
Guest panel speaker for 'Queer and Colored' youth QA session. 
Discussed what it is like living as a queer Latina. 
Provided advice and encouragement to the youth to embrace who they are regardless of their color and personal differences.

company.name: Rainbow Community Center of Contra Costa

volunteerExperiences.description:
Meet with students to help with homework, papers, and learning assistance. Subject matters vary from student to student and may include mathematics, science, and literacy.

Assisted parents and teens in filling out their first FAFSA form online. Focused on the Spanish group to translate questions and provide understanding of the application process.
